kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نقشعر (form IVq)
# نَقْشَعِرُّ (naqšaʕirru) /naq.ʃa.ʕir.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِقْشَعَرَّ (iqšaʕarra)
# نَقْشَعِرَّ (naqšaʕirra) /naq.ʃa.ʕir.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْشَعَرَّ (iqšaʕarra)
# نَقْشَعِرِّ (naqšaʕirri) /naq.ʃa.ʕir.ri/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِقْشَعَرَّ (iqšaʕarra)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
